description: Fixed 20-task Terminal-Bench 4.1 subset for VeriLoop self-evolution experiments, split 10/10 into evolve and held-out halves. Not a full Terminal-Bench 4.1 run and must not be reported as one.

selection_policy.source: eval/benchmarks/data/tb41_tasks.json (task.toml metadata) plus each task's environment/Dockerfile and tests/
selection_policy.frozen_before_results: Chosen from metadata and environment files only, never from any agent's pass/fail results, so rerunning the subset cannot show a regression-to-the-mean improvement. Public per-task solve rates were not used.
selection_policy.runnable: No GPU; task environment and verifier environment both within 4 CPUs and 8 GB (excludes 16 GB and 8-CPU tasks such as medical-claims-processing, formal-crypto, shadow-relay, and payments-pipeline-fix whose verifier needs 8 CPUs / 16 GB); no CPU-served LLM inference (sglang-qwen-burst, vllm-deepseek-streaming); no nested VM (uefi-bootkit).
selection_policy.not_too_hard: Shortest runnable tasks by expert_time_estimate_hours (0.75-4 h; the benchmark median is about 4 h).
selection_policy.diversity: All 7 categories covered; near-duplicate variant layout-config-recreation2 excluded to avoid leakage across the split.
selection_policy.split: 10/10 stratified by category, with total expert hours close (evolve 22.75 h, held-out 20.25 h).

run_policy.model: deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at selection time), intensity normal (thinking on, reasoning_effort=high)
run_policy.pin: Record the model identifier returned by the API on every run; rerun the baseline if it changes.
run_policy.concurrency: 1 on a 6-CPU / 6 GB machine; several tasks request 8 GB and some run extra service containers.

needs_check.html-js-filter: Its verifier image was tuned for Modal's sandbox; confirm the separate verifier builds and runs under local Docker, otherwise replace it from backups before any agent result is seen.
needs_check.multi_service: intrastat-meldung and legacy-utility-triage start extra service containers; watch memory on a 6 GB host.

backups.rule: Replace a task only if it cannot run in the environment (image build failure, verifier infrastructure unavailable), decided before seeing any agent result, with a backup in the same split; record the replacement.
